content.short: Datawallet is a daily crypto newsletter offering tools for staking, market data, and ETF flows.
content.description: Datawallet provides direct access to essential crypto market data, bringing together key metrics in a single, easy-to-use dashboard. You can monitor funding rates, open interest, ETF flows, and staking rewards in one place, eliminating the need to jump between multiple platforms. The daily newsletter delivers clear, timely insights that help you spot trends, assess risk, and make informed decisions with confidence. Designed for both beginners and active traders, Datawallet equips you with practical tools and trustworthy information to stay ahead without unnecessary noise.
